subject: Taxes
title: What Happens If You Don't File
description: One-minute skill: What Happens If You Don't File.

hook.text: Not filing your taxes is a federal crime. The penalty for fraud is up to 5 years in prison and $250,000 in fines.

buildup.text: Even if you can't pay, you must still file. The failure-to-file penalty is 5% per month, up to 25% of what you owe.

discovery.text: The IRS rarely prosecutes late filers. They focus enforcement on deliberate fraud and high-dollar evasion cases.

twist.text: If you're owed a refund and don't file, the IRS keeps your money.

climax.text: Not filing is almost always worse than filing and owing.

punchline.text: Can't pay? File anyway. Hiding is always worse than owing.
